Purple flecks may enlarge into leaf spots; fruit rot and cankers can occur, but diagnosis must be separated from scab and bitter rot. Use the symptom pattern to distinguish this class from look-alike disorders. 2. Targeted Chemical Control: No universal chemical rate is stored for this class. Prune out cankers and mummies, confirm the diagnosis, then use only a current registered apple label. 3. Organic / Biological Alternative: Remove mummified fruit and dead wood from the orchard; disinfect pruning tools between suspect trees. 4. Live Weather & Cultural Prevention: Farmer is preparing a 20 L knapsack. Calibrate the sprayer and mix only the label rate; do not exceed concentration. Avoid application if rain is expected within 4-6 hours or wind exceeds 12 km/h. Prune in dry weather, improve airflow and avoid leaving infected prunings in the orchard. Use PPE, respect the pre-harvest interval, and follow the product label.
